title: General Settings: Website Logo, Contact Info and Brand Colors

sections.heading: General Settings Navigation
sections.content: All core branding settings are located under Settings > General Settings. Here you can upload your high-resolution website logo, enter primary contact phone numbers, define the default currency, and set your company physical address.

sections.heading: Logo Dimensions and Requirements
sections.content: For optimal display across desktop and mobile browsers, upload a transparent PNG logo. Recommended logo dimensions are 400px wide by 100px high. Click 'Upload Logo' under the Brand Identity tab, then click 'Save Changes'.

procedural_steps: Click Upload Logo and select your transparent PNG file
Enter company phone number, email, and address

images.surrounding_context: Navigate to Settings > General Settings. Click Brand Identity tab to upload website logo.

enriched_images.visual_description: Admin panel displaying Settings > General Settings with tabs: General, Brand Identity, Localization, Contact Info. Shows file uploader button 'Upload Logo' and 'Save Changes'.

full_text:
General Settings Navigation
All core branding settings are located under Settings > General Settings. Here you can upload your high-resolution website logo, enter primary contact phone numbers, define the default currency, and set your company physical address.

Logo Dimensions and Requirements
For optimal display across desktop and mobile browsers, upload a transparent PNG logo. Recommended logo dimensions are 400px wide by 100px high. Click 'Upload Logo' under the Brand Identity tab, then click 'Save Changes'.
